name: gingerbread_house
description: A gingerbread cottage on a snowy cake board: piped icing on every edge, a peppermint-striped roof with icicle drips, gumdrops, a candy-cane porch, a cookie door, glowing sugar-glass windows and a chimney, with a gingerbread owl-man and two sugared firs in the garden.
author: Hoot Hollow (furnC lowpix kit)
